mapper.select: SELECT * FROM auth_token WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_token SET expires_at = LEAST(expires_at, #{now}) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = 'email_verify' AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS amount, MIN(created_at) AS oldest FROM auth_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND created_at > #{time}
